dedupe_keys.name: china solar radiation deep networks training data and checkpoints

description: This Figshare collection publishes the modelling components used to estimate surface global and diffuse solar radiation over China. The research team supplies two Python routines for training and fine-tuning the networks, HDF5 training data, station altitudes, constraint simulations from SBDART and two saved best-performing model checkpoints. The short README identifies the role of every file, and all ten collection members state CC0, allowing free reuse. The collection is associated with the 2007–2018 China radiation study; the training bundle itself is not a complete sequence of gridded predictions. It can reproduce or adapt radiation estimates used as photovoltaic simulation inputs, alongside asset locations such as data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that checkpoint quality outside the training setting and compatibility with current neural-network libraries were not tested. The own landing pages do not specify a supported environment or guarantee transfer to other satellite sensors. Only metadata and the short README were read; no weights, training arrays or software archive were downloaded.
